case_pass_rule: A case passes only if every assertion attached to it passes: contract_validity (gate), false_positive_avoidance, issue_classification, evidence_grounding, plus contradiction_detection and actionable_feedback on cases with blocking reference labels. High scores elsewhere never compensate for a failed assertion.

metric_definitions.critical_detection_rate: critical reference labels detected / critical reference labels (over cases with blocking labels)
metric_definitions.false_positive_rate: expected-PASS cases where the reviewer returned a verdict other than PASS or any critical/major issue / expected-PASS cases
metric_definitions.false_negative_rate: expected-REVISE or expected-PUNCH_OUT cases where the reviewer returned PASS / those cases
metric_definitions.blocking_precision: reported critical/major issues matching a blocking reference label / reported critical/major issues
metric_definitions.blocking_recall: blocking reference labels detected / blocking reference labels
metric_definitions.verdict_accuracy: cases where verdict equals expected verdict / cases
metric_definitions.evidence_grounding_rate: reported issues passing the deterministic grounding check / reported issues
metric_definitions.contract_validity_rate: reviewer responses accepted by the strict shared contract parser / cases
metric_definitions.weighted_score: mean over cases of sum(weight*score over applicable criteria)/sum(weight over applicable criteria)
